title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode1 Between Worlds

meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's great to see you so soon in the new year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's make this year wonderful too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for looking after everyone with me last year. You were so helpful!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I was also able to have an amazing year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you be able to help me keep an eye on everyone this year too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yay!
I was hoping you'd say that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope this turns out to be another great year. For us here in SEKAI, for our friends from the real world, for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That includes you too, of course!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, would you like to go over to SEKAI together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm really curious to see how everyone's celebrating the New Year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's go check up on everyone!
